cybersecurityLessons.principle: Client vs Server Secret Boundary Leakage
cybersecurityLessons.explanation: Next.js and frontend frameworks distinguish between public (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) and server-only environment variables. Exposing database service-role keys to client bundles bypasses all backend authentication.
